title: T-01 Create GitHub repo, push the starter project, enable CI
body:
Starter project is in the zip (backend, frontend, docs, CI workflow).
Done when: repo is on GitHub, CI run is green, supervisor has been added if required.
Ticket: T-01

title: T-02 Import tickets and set up the project board
body:
Run scripts/create_issues.py (dry run first). Board columns: Backlog, This week, In progress, Review, Done.
Done when: every ticket exists, has a week milestone and appears on the board.
Ticket: T-02

title: T-03 Build the 6 wireframes in Figma
body:
Follow docs/wireframes-figma-spec.md.
Done when: six frames exist with the shared component set, empty/loading/error states are marked, and each frame is annotated with its requirement IDs.

Requirements: FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-8, FR-13, FR-14, NFR-3, NFR-6, NFR-7
Ticket: T-03

title: T-04 Check the database schema against the ER diagram
body:
Schema and tests are in backend/db and backend/tests. Read docs/schema-notes.md and settle decisions D-1 to D-7.
Done when: tests pass on your machine and every decision is recorded as accepted or changed.

Requirements: FR-7, FR-8, NFR-7
Ticket: T-04

title: T-05 Review the API endpoint list
body:
See docs/api.md.
Done when: endpoints are agreed, and any endpoint that needs a schema change is linked to the matching decision in docs/schema-notes.md.

Requirements: FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-8, FR-13, FR-14, NFR-5, NFR-6
Ticket: T-05

title: T-06 Write the metric formulas with worked examples
body:
Not started in the starter project on purpose. Cover adherence %, weight trend, sleep consistency and strength estimate, each with inputs, formula, minimum data and at least two worked examples with numbers.
Blocked by decisions D-2 (counting completed sessions) and D-5 (sleep data per check-in).
Done when: every formula can be turned directly into a unit test.

Requirements: FR-9, FR-12, NFR-4, NFR-8, P-2
Ticket: T-06

title: T-07 Message the supervisor about ethics, the checkpoint and the submission date
body:
Draft is in docs/supervisor-message.md. Send it through Blackboard, not email.
Done when: you have a written answer on whether the questionnaire needs ethics clearance and what the real submission date is.
Ticket: T-07

title: T-08 Finalise the questionnaire
body:
Draft is in docs/questionnaire.md. Pilot it with two people and trim anything they stumble on.
Done when: it is built in your form tool, consent text is included, and it is cleared to send (see ethics ticket).
Ticket: T-08

title: T-09 Run the hello-world check end to end
body:
Follow the README.
Done when: the page shows Client, Server and Database as Working.
Ticket: T-09

title: T-10 Registration and login
body:
Hash passwords with a slow hash (argon2 or bcrypt). Return a signed token. Reject unauthenticated calls to every profile endpoint.
Done when: tests cover duplicate email, wrong password and missing token.

Requirements: FR-1, FR-2, NFR-5
Ticket: T-10

title: T-11 Onboarding form and baseline profile
body:
Fields: training schedule, diet pattern, weight, height, sleep habits, goals. Keep it to three short steps.
Done when: a new user finishes onboarding and a baseline snapshot exists.

Requirements: FR-3, FR-4
Ticket: T-11

title: T-12 Versioned snapshots: create and retrieve by date
body:
Never update a snapshot; always insert. Retrieval returns the snapshot in effect on a given date.
Done when: tests prove old snapshots are unchanged after a new one is added.

Requirements: FR-7, FR-8
Ticket: T-12

title: T-13 Send the questionnaire
body:
Done when: the link is out to your target group and you have a response target (for example 30).
Ticket: T-13

title: T-14 Weekly check-in form
body:
At most two menu levels. Prefill from last week. Sleep, diet and loads are optional.
Done when: a check-in saves and creates a new snapshot linked one-to-one.

Requirements: FR-5, NFR-3
Ticket: T-14

title: T-15 One-tap 'done as planned' logging
body:
Done when: logging a planned session takes one tap and no typing.

Requirements: FR-6
Ticket: T-15

title: T-16 Adherence percentage with unit tests
body:
Implements the formula from the metric formulas ticket as a pure function.
Done when: tests match your hand-calculated worked examples.

Requirements: FR-9, NFR-4, NFR-8
Ticket: T-16

title: T-17 Weight trend with unit tests
body:
Done when: tests match worked examples, including a case with too little data.

Requirements: FR-12, NFR-4, NFR-8
Ticket: T-17

title: T-18 Collect questionnaire responses
body:
Done when: you have reached the response target or the deadline you set.
Ticket: T-18

title: T-19 Sleep consistency and minimum-data rules
body:
A metric with too little data returns 'not enough data' instead of a number.
Done when: tests cover sparse and missing data.

Requirements: P-2, NFR-4, NFR-8
Ticket: T-19

title: T-20 Strength progression estimate (cut first if behind)
body:
Optional load entry only. Estimates are labelled as estimates.
Done when: tests cover missing loads.

Requirements: P-2, NFR-8
Ticket: T-20

title: T-21 Evidence rule set, versioned and separate from code
body:
Rules stored as data with description, citation and version, using the studies cited in the proposal.
Done when: rules load from the database and a version change does not need a code change.

Requirements: FR-13, NFR-7
Ticket: T-21

title: T-22 Rule-based suggestions
body:
Metrics in, rule matches out, with no LLM. This is the fallback and Milestone A.
Done when: each user with enough data gets a suggestion built only from rules.

Requirements: FR-13
Ticket: T-22

title: T-23 'Why this suggestion' display
body:
Shows the metrics and rules behind every suggestion.
Done when: no suggestion is displayed without its source metrics.

Requirements: FR-14, NFR-7
Ticket: T-23

title: T-24 Analyse the questionnaire and refine priorities
body:
Done when: findings are summarised in a short table and any priority changes are written down (scope stays inside the proposal).
Ticket: T-24

title: T-25 Server-side LLM call and prompt builder
body:
The API key stays on the server. The prompt contains computed metrics and rules, never raw identifiers.
Done when: a suggestion is generated within your timing target and responses are cached for tests.

Requirements: FR-13, NFR-1
Ticket: T-25

title: T-26 Consent gate before any external LLM call
body:
Done when: without consent the app uses the rule-based path and sends nothing out.

Requirements: NFR-6
Ticket: T-26

title: T-27 Guardrails and the not-medical-advice notice
body:
Done when: medical questions are redirected, implausible inputs are queried, and the notice is always visible.

Requirements: P-3
Ticket: T-27

title: T-28 Fallback when the LLM is unavailable
body:
Done when: switching the API off still returns metrics and rule-based suggestions.

Requirements: P-4, NFR-1
Ticket: T-28

title: T-29 Persona generator
body:
Synthetic users with configurable adherence, progression and logging frequency. Use the '@sim.local' email convention (decision D-4).
Done when: a persona produces a realistic 12-week history from a single command.

Requirements: P-1
Ticket: T-29

title: T-30 Run personas through weeks 1, 6 and 12
body:
Done when: each timepoint stores its recommendation and a simulation run record.

Requirements: P-1
Ticket: T-30

title: T-31 Profile comparison view: week 1 against week 12
body:
Done when: you can show side by side how the profile and suggestions changed.

Requirements: FR-8, P-1
Ticket: T-31

title: T-32 Data export and delete
body:
Done when: a user can download their data and delete their account, and deletion leaves no rows behind (already tested at database level).

Requirements: P-5, NFR-5
Ticket: T-32

title: T-33 Profile dashboard visuals (stretch)
body:
Only after the MVP tests pass.

Requirements: FR-9, FR-12
Ticket: T-33

title: T-34 Third persona (stretch)
body:
Only after the MVP tests pass.

Requirements: P-1
Ticket: T-34

title: T-35 Integration and guardrail tests
body:
Done when: the full path from check-in to explained suggestion is covered by automated tests.

Requirements: NFR-4, NFR-6, NFR-7, NFR-8, P-3, P-4
Ticket: T-35

title: T-36 Evaluation script and results tables
body:
Measures: rule compliance, specificity checklist, consistency across repeated generations, change across timepoints.
Done when: one command regenerates every number in your results.

Requirements: P-1
Ticket: T-36

title: T-37 Raw logs versus computed metrics comparison (only if supervisor approves)
body:
Done when: approval is on record and a second prompt variant runs through the same evaluation script.

Requirements: P-1
Ticket: T-37

title: T-38 Usability walkthrough with 3-5 students (optional)
body:
Done when: check-in time and stumbling points are recorded.

Requirements: NFR-3
Ticket: T-38

title: T-39 Feature freeze
body:
From here only bug fixes and writing.
Ticket: T-39

title: T-40 Add implementation, results and limitations to the document; update the Gantt chart
body:
Done when: Chapter 4 timeline matches what you actually did and limitations are stated plainly.
Ticket: T-40

title: T-41 Demo script with an offline fallback
body:
Done when: you can demo with the network off using recorded or cached responses.
Ticket: T-41

title: T-42 Update slides and rehearse
body:
Done when: you have rehearsed twice and have a spare day before submission.
Ticket: T-42
